Hi Michael —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and next steps from our call: 

- SOC 2: you asked for our current SOC 2 Type II status and a PDF snapshot of the report.
- Incident response & notifications: you want details on our IR timelines (detection, notification, remediation) and any regulatory notification commitments (HIPAA/GDPR considerations).
- BCP/DR evidence: list of artifacts you commonly request for procurement (DR exercises, RTO/RPO metrics, runbook excerpts).
- Vendor questionnaire: you mentioned a vendor security questionnaire — if you can share the spreadsheet, we can start populating it and assign owners.

Next steps (action items):
1) I will send a snapshot of our latest SOC 2 Type II summary and a short IR timeline doc by EOD today.
2) Laura will coordinate any additional compliance evidence (BCP/DR) and share an evidence bundle.
3) If Samantha (procurement) sends the XLS, Marissa will own initial answers and loop in product security for technical questions.

Please confirm if this matches your expectations or if I missed anything.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake

Jordan —

Appreciate the recap — that looks good. A few clarifications: 

- SOC 2: we need a redacted copy of the Type II report if possible (or the auditor's letter + control matrix). A summary PDF is fine to start; procurement will request the full report under NDA later.
- IR timelines: please include the maximum notification window to customers for incidents affecting confidentiality or integrity, and whether Redwood has contractual SLAs for notification.
- GDPR/HIPAA: FinTechCorp processes EU personal data for EU customers and has some contracts in healthcare. Please flag any HIPAA-related controls or attestations if you have handled PHI for customers.
- BCP/DR: we commonly request evidence of last tabletop exercise and RTO/RPO targets for critical services (authentication, inference, control plane).

I'll attach the vendor questionnaire we use in procurement. Samantha will take point on commercial questions.

Subject: Re: FinTechCorp — Security & Incident Response follow-up / SOC 2 status

Michael / Samantha —

Thanks — placing the questionnaire in our queue. Per the attachments I sent last night, here are the specifics you asked for: 

1) SOC 2: attached summary is a high-level snapshot of our latest SOC 2 Type II period (Jan 2025–Dec 2025). We can provide a redacted auditor letter and control matrix under an NDA; if procurement would like that, I can route to Legal/Compliance and expedite.

2) Incident response & notification timelines (summary):
- Detection: median time to detection for high-severity events (internal monitoring + managed services) — 4 hours (we will provide telemetry examples under NDA).
- Initial internal escalation: within 1 hour of confirmed detection.
- Customer notification: contractual commitment is 72 hours for incidents with confirmed customer data exposure; operational target is 24–48 hours depending on scope.
- Remediation/containment: time-to-containment varies by incident class; for infrastructure-level incidents our target MTTR for containment is 24–72 hours.

We do not currently have a specific HIPAA attestation (we do not host PHI as a managed service for customers), but we can provide controls mapping for GDPR data processing and support contractual clauses (DPA).

3) BCP/DR evidence: Laura will share an evidence bundle (last tabletop from 2026-03, RTO/RPO for inference/control-plane, and runbook excerpts).

4) Vendor questionnaire: attached please find our initial answers (Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx). Marissa will follow-up on technical controls and will ping Product Security for deep technical replies.

I attached a short IR plan (IR_plan_v2.pdf) and an evidence zip with the items Laura will share. Let me know if you need a formal NDA to unlock the full SOC 2 artifacts.

Best,
Jordan

Attachments: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx, IR_plan_v2.pdf, BCP_DR_evidence.zip
